mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows, which compresses risk premiums and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 4.0% triggers heightened inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to raise rates, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In non-inflationary regimes, the negative returns from Fed rate hikes persist beyond 20 days despite the UNRATE trigger, or the t-test p-value exceeds 0.05 when comparing to baseline returns.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3% in the prior quarter signals robust economic momentum, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day returns do not outperform a 5-day moving average of baseline returns (t-test p > 0.05) in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in HOUST (household consumption) indicates strengthening consumer spending, which amplifies corporate revenue growth and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day returns fail to exceed the 20-day moving average of baseline returns in >60% of instances where HOUST trends upward.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above 105.0 (from 2017=100) indicates expanding industrial output, which supports corporate investment and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizons, the 5-day INDPRO increases fail to predict positive returns with statistical significance (p > 0.05) in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (GDP growth) and HOUST (household consumption) above their 10-year moving averages indicates robust demand-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint GDPC1-HOUST effect does not produce significantly higher returns than either proxy alone (p > 0.05) in 70% of interaction periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDPC1 (GDP growth) and RSAFS (small business credit) above their 5-year averages signals robust demand-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day returns from GDPC1-RSAFS interaction do not exceed the average of individual proxy returns in >50% of cases, with p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery regime, a sharp decline in UNRATE below 3.5% triggers increased hiring optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In non-labor-recovery regimes, the UNRATE-driven returns do not outperform baseline by 1% or more in >60% of instances, or the t-test p-value exceeds 0.05.
